projects.title: Lemmy Nanny
projects.description: A project mostly hand written to use AI (Ollama local models) to monitor Lemmy instances to add to a mod to a mod queue so moderators can keep their Lemmy instances tidy.

projects.title: Ketamine Dreams
projects.description: Started as a fork of LMStudioWebUI, but I have been working on it to make it more user friendly and add more features. I was then playing with AI to make some psychedelic art and then I started to make it a personal art project
